# ASP.NET Core

Create an ASP.NET Core project via:

```bash
stoke init aspnet-core
```

Generates a minimal API project — the lightweight ASP.NET Core style without controllers/MVC scaffolding.

## Prompts

- **Project name**: directory name for the project

## Generated files

    myapp/
    ├── stoke.toml
    ├── myapp.csproj              # Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web, generated by `dotnet new web` if dotnet is installed
    └── Program.cs                 # minimal API entry point

## Dependencies

- None beyond the ASP.NET Core shared framework (no NuGet packages needed for the minimal API template)

## Default settings

- **Port**: `5000` (hardcoded via `app.Run("http://localhost:5000")` — avoids the HTTPS dev-certificate prompt from the default template)
- **Endpoints**:
  - `GET /` → `Hello from ASP.NET Core + stoke!`
  - `GET /hello/{name}` → `Hello, {name}!`

## Run

```bash
cd myapp
stoke build
stoke run
```

Open `http://localhost:5000/`

## Customization

- Change port: edit `app.Run("http://localhost:5000")` in `Program.cs`
- Add routes: add `app.MapGet(...)` / `app.MapPost(...)` calls
- Add services: use `builder.Services.Add...()` before `builder.Build()`
